sources.entry: scrapling - An adaptive scraping framework whose selectors relocate elements after page changes, with stealth fetchers and spiders.

summary.one_liner: Scrapling is a Python web scraping framework combining fast HTTP requests, stealth browser fetchers, adaptive parsing, and a concurrent spider crawler in one library.
summary.what_it_does: Provides HTTP fetchers with browser TLS/header impersonation, browser-based fetchers (Playwright Chromium and Chrome) with stealth and Cloudflare Turnstile/Interstitial handling, and persistent sessions for cookies and state. Parsing supports CSS, XPath, text, regex, and BeautifulSoup-style searches, plus adaptive element tracking that relocates elements after page changes and similar-element matching. A Scrapy-like Spider API runs concurrent crawls with proxy rotation, retries, AutoThrottle, robots.txt compliance, pause/resume via a crawldir, and JSON/JSONL/CSV/XML export. It also offers a CLI, an interactive shell, an MCP server for AI agents, an Agent Skill, and Markdown output for RAG-style use.
use_cases: scrape static web pages for specific fields
scrape JavaScript-rendered sites with a browser
run large resumable crawls of a website
export scraped data to JSON or CSV
convert web pages to Markdown for LLMs
let an AI agent browse and extract web data
notable: Adaptive element tracking that relocates selectors after website changes
Spider API with multi-session routing across HTTP and stealth browsers
Pause and resume crawls with crawldir and Ctrl+C checkpoints
MCP server and Agent Skill so AI coding agents use the current API
Background API capture via record_requests and session.network.search
caveats: Base install includes only the parser; fetchers and spiders need 'scrapling[fetchers]' and a separate 'scrapling install' step for browsers
Several README sections are sponsor advertisements for paid proxy and anti-bot services, which are not part of the project
Disclaimer states it is for educational and research purposes; users must follow site terms and robots.txt
